prompt: What problem does the woman notice in the fitting mirror?
promptZh: 女方注意到試衣鏡有什麼問題？

options.text: It is hard to see the bottom of the coat.
options.whyZh: 陽光反射讓外套的下襬變得很難看清楚。

options.text: The shoulders of the coat appear uneven.
options.zh: 外套的兩肩看起來不對稱。
options.whyZh: 她說看得清楚肩部，沒有說肩部不對稱。

options.text: A crack runs all the way across the mirror.
options.zh: 鏡面有一道裂痕橫跨整面鏡子。
options.whyZh: 看不清楚是陽光反射所致，不是鏡面破裂。

options.text: The mirror keeps moving during fittings.
options.whyZh: 女方指出的是反光；沒有說鏡子會在試穿時移動。

explanationZh: 陽光反射讓外套的下襬變得很難看清楚。
evidence: The late sun is hitting the fitting mirror. I can see the shoulders of this coat just fine, but the bottom almost disappears in the glare.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The late sun is hitting the fitting mirror. I can see the shoulders of this coat just fine, but the bottom almost disappears in the glare.

vocabulary.note: 在此指斜射陽光讓鏡中的外套下半部難以看清。
